description: This file defines a Java interface 'BackgroundSyncConfig' that specifies configuration parameters for a background synchronization process, including methods for retrieving various timeout and throttle settings, as well as default configuration values encapsulated in an enum.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncConfig
classes.description: An interface extending BackgroundStreamingConfig that provides configuration methods for background sync behavior and a nested enum for default config values.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncConfig.ConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration listing configuration keys and default values for background sync settings.

methods.name: boolean isEnabled()
methods.description: Determines if background sync is enabled.

methods.name: Duration getQuietPeriod()
methods.description: Gets the delay before starting background sync after startup and between progress flushes.

methods.name: int getKeptEvents()
methods.description: Retrieves the number of events to keep in actor state.

methods.name: Duration getToleranceWindow()
methods.description: Gets the allowed staleness window for search index entries.

methods.name: int getThrottleThroughput()
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of things to update per throttle period.

methods.name: Duration getIdleTimeout()
methods.description: Gets the timeout duration for idle stream before failure.

methods.name: Duration getPolicyAskTimeout()
methods.description: Returns the timeout for policy shard requests.

methods.name: Duration getMinBackoff()
methods.description: Gets the minimum backoff duration after stream failure.

methods.name: Duration getMaxBackoff()
methods.description: Gets the maximum backoff duration after stream failure.

methods.name: int getMaxRestarts()
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of restarts allowed after upstream failure.

methods.name: Duration getRecovery()
methods.description: Gets the duration the stream must run error-free before back-off resets.
